app.name: DIASA
app.tagline: Centralized emergency reporting. Clearer incident management.

auth.signInDescription: Use your authorized DIASA account to manage incidents.
auth.resetDescription: Enter the email address associated with your authorized DIASA account.
auth.resetSent: If this is an authorized account, a password reset email has been sent.
auth.resetError: Unable to send the reset email. Check the address and try again.
auth.signInError: Sign-in failed. Check your administrator email and password.
auth.unauthorized: This account is not authorized as a DIASA administrator.

report.title: Report an emergency
report.description: Provide clear information so authorized responders can review the incident quickly.
report.successDescription: Share this reference with a DIASA administrator if you need to follow up.
report.classificationNotice: This preliminary classification is a software priority indicator, not official emergency triage.
report.submitError: Unable to submit the report. Please try again.
